tools.name: coder_library_search
tools.description: Search Coder libraries. source=registry selects Arduino official packages from the regional libraries-coder-index.json, returning coder:@aily-project-coder/lib-* refs. source=aily (default) searches Aily libraries using the shared Blockly libraries.json and libraries-index.json. Results return exact refs, installedVersion, installed/managed state, compatibility and compatibleAlternatives, package-local sourceDirectory/libraryRoots, and any editable localRoots. Installed npm archives are ready only after src.7z is safely expanded beside the archive to node_modules/<package>/src. Use coder_library_localize before changing package library source.

query.description: Prefer an exact library name when known. Additional functionality keywords are ranking hints; verify actual capabilities from result metadata and the installed API.

detail.description: Summary keeps identity, compatibility, dependencies and usable paths. Use full with an exact name for all metadata; use offset/limit to page. Descriptions are not truncated.

forceRefresh.description: Refresh the selected library catalog from the current regional resource.

source.description: aily: shared Blockly/Aily packages. registry: Arduino official npm packages from the regional libraries-coder-index.json.

tools.name: coder_library_install
tools.description: Install one exact result from coder_library_search. Incompatible libraries are rejected unless allowIncompatible=true under the explicit named-library confirmation policy; if confirmation times out, is skipped, or is unavailable, follow the user's still-authoritative explicit named-library request and disclose the warning. Aily and Arduino official packages share npm installation and safely expand src.7z beside the archive into node_modules/<package>/src. Require ready=true, packageJsonLinked=true, sourceLayout=package-local and non-empty libraryRoots. sourceReady alone does not prove dependencies are complete: resolve dependencyIssues before building; dependencyStatus=unknown means legacy sources lack metadata. No compilation is performed. Never edit returned package-local paths directly; call coder_library_localize first when customization is required.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef returned by coder_library_search.

allowIncompatible.description: Explicit compatibility override. Set true only for a user-named library after confirmation, or when that confirmation timed out, was skipped, or was unavailable while the user's original request explicitly required installing this library.

tools.name: coder_library_localize
tools.description: Copy an installed npm-backed Aily or Arduino official library root into the real project sketch/libraries directory before changing library code. Pass the exact libraryRef, installedVersion, and, for a multi-root result, the exact libraryRoot returned by coder_library_search or coder_library_install. The package-local source remains npm-managed; the copied local root becomes editable project source and takes precedence during builds. This operation is idempotent for a root already localized from the same package and never overwrites an independent local library.

libraryRef.description: Exact npm-backed libraryRef returned by coder_library_search.

libraryRoot.description: Optional exact package-local libraryRoots entry. Required to select one root when the package exposes multiple roots.

tools.name: coder_library_remove
tools.description: Remove one exact installed Aily or Arduino official npm library. First search and require installed=true and managed=true; copy libraryRef and installedVersion. Removal deletes the root npm dependency and package-local extracted source with the npm package, while preserving every copy localized under sketch/libraries. Existing legacy managed ZIP libraries remain removable by their original refs.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef originally returned by coder_library_search.

version.description: Exact installedVersion returned by coder_library_search; do not substitute the catalog's selected version.
